biblical_reference.verse_reference: Book of Samuel 1:1-17, specifically verses 11 and 12
biblical_reference.note: Noam is the name of the son born to Hannah, the wife of Elkanah, after she had been barren for many years. The name Noam means 'comforter,' and it is prophesied that his name will be 'a name more renowned than Samuel.'
